name: Nesso (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Nesso (a tree on a hill beneath three stars) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI NESSO in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Nesso, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 9 October 2002.

features.role: Nesso arms — tree on a hill beneath three stars, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI NESSO arched above the arms
